title: Altinn localtest test data (testData.json), v3
description: Test users, organisations and systems for local testing of Altinn apps: the Register component's built-in seed and every app's App/wwwroot/testData.json. v3 of the test-users line (v1 is published at altinncdn.no; v2 was a localtest-only name). Not published to the CDN: this copy lives in localtest/testdata/ of the localtest research repository. Field reference: localtest/testdata/README.md. The loader is more lenient than this schema: unknown properties are ignored and property names are case-insensitive.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The schema this file follows. The loader ignores it; editors use it for completion and validation.

persons.title: Persons
persons.description: Test users: persons with a national identity number, or self-identified users (empty ssn, identified by e-mail). Each person is a Register party, a Profile user and a login in the picker.

orgs.title: Organisations
orgs.description: Organisations (main units and sub-units) as Register parties from the Central Coordinating Register.

systems.title: Systems
systems.description: Systems (end-user systems) with their system users; each system user becomes a Register system-user party owned by an organisation in this or another loaded file. null is read as an empty list.

partyId.title: Party id
partyId.description: Altinn 2 party id (a positive integer), unique across persons and organisations of all loaded files.

partyUuid.title: Party UUID
partyUuid.description: The party's UUID. Default when absent or null: the party id zero-padded into a UUID (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000510001 for 510001). Must be a real UUID when the party is used for instance delegation (for example parallel signing).

organisationNumber.title: Organisation number
organisationNumber.description: Nine-digit Norwegian organisation number. The Register also checks the mod-11 control digit and skips an organisation that fails it, with a load warning.

mobileNumber.title: Mobile number
mobileNumber.description: Mobile number in full international form: '+', the country code and the number, 8 to 15 digits in all (E.164), such as +4799315829. Production Notifications rejects a bare eight-digit number as a direct SMS recipient and adds +47 to Profile contact points only when they start with 4 or 9; the number must also be valid for libphonenumber (Norwegian mobile numbers start with 4 or 9). Returned by the Profile lookups exactly as written.

email.title: E-mail address
email.description: E-mail address, returned by the Profile lookups exactly as written.

role.title: Role
role.description: One role a person holds for a party.

type.title: Role type
type.description: Role source as the old localtest wrote it (altinn or Altinn). Kept for compatibility; not read.

value.title: Role code
value.description: Altinn role code (DAGL, REGNA, PRIV, A0239, ...) or a CCR role identifier (daglig-leder). CCR codes held for an organisation become external role assignments in the Register; every code is passed verbatim to Access Management as an Altinn 2 role code.

customClaim.title: Custom claim
customClaim.description: An extra claim for the user's tokens (old localtest). Exposed by the Register's test-users endpoint; no component of the new stack adds it to tokens yet.

notificationAddress.title: Official notification address
notificationAddress.description: One official notification address of an organisation (varslingsadresse in the contact register for organisations), either an e-mail address or a mobile number. Production Profile stores one record per address; its lookup splits them into emailList and mobileNumberList.

mobileNumber.title: Mobile number
mobileNumber.description: Official notification mobile number in full international form (+47...), what Profile stores as the full address (country code plus number).

person.title: Person
person.description: A test user. With an 11-digit ssn: a person from the national population register. With an empty ssn: a self-identified user registered by e-mail through ID-porten (email required; names and userName are not used).

ssn.title: National identity number
ssn.description: Eleven-digit Norwegian national identity number (fødselsnummer or D-number; synthetic Tenor numbers have month + 80), or an empty string for a self-identified user. The Register checks the mod-11 control digits and skips a person that fails them, with a load warning.

userId.title: User id
userId.description: Altinn user id, unique across all loaded files. The login picker, tokens (urn:altinn:userid) and Profile use it.

firstName.title: First name
firstName.description: First name. The display name is first, middle and last name joined by spaces.

lastName.title: Last name
lastName.description: Last name. Person lookups by national identity number and last name match on it.

userName.title: User name
userName.description: Altinn user name; Profile can look a user up by it.

email.title: E-mail address
email.description: The person's e-mail address (Profile; the contact point Notifications and the KRR stand-in use). For a self-identified user it is the identity: urn:altinn:person:idporten-email:<email>, stored lower-case, and the display name.

preSelectedPartyId.title: Preselected party (v2)
preSelectedPartyId.description: Profile: the party preselected in the party picker. Default 0 (none).

doNotPromptForParty.title: Do not prompt for party (v2)
doNotPromptForParty.description: Profile: skip the party picker and use the preselected or own party. Default false.

telephoneNumber.title: Telephone number
telephoneNumber.description: Fixed-line telephone number. The KRR stand-in (and through it Profile's phoneNumber and contact point lookups) uses it only when mobileNumber is absent.

mobileNumber.description: The person's mobile number in full international form (+47...): through the KRR stand-in, Profile's phoneNumber and the SMS contact point Notifications gets from Profile's users/contactpoint/lookup. Tightened in v3: v1 accepted any string.

reserved.title: Reserved against digital contact (v3)
reserved.description: The person is reserved in KRR, the contact and reservation register, against digital communication from the public sector. Default false. The Register's KRR stand-in answers reservasjon JA for the person, which Correspondence checks recipients against and Profile's KRR sync copies into isReserved (users/contactpoint/lookup), so Notifications does not send to the person unless the order sets ignoreReservation. Has no meaning for a self-identified user.

partyRoles.title: Party roles
partyRoles.description: Roles the person holds, keyed by the party id they are held for: an organisation, another person, or the person's own party (PRIV, REGNA, DAGL on oneself, which policies grant on). An empty list means the person may act for the party without any role.

accessPackages.title: Access packages (v2)
accessPackages.description: Access packages (tilgangspakker) the person holds, keyed by the party id of the organisation they are held for. Values are package identifiers or full URNs (urn:altinn:accesspackage:...). Applied by Access Management's refresh; the PDP reads them from there.

customClaims.title: Custom claims
customClaims.description: Extra claims for the user's tokens (old localtest). Exposed by the Register's test-users endpoint; not added to tokens by the new stack yet.

profile.title: Profile data (reserved, v3)
profile.description: Reserved for Profile data that is not seeded yet (favourites, professional notification settings, verified addresses; task 14 seeds only the fields above). No fields are defined yet; only an empty object validates. The loader ignores it.

org.title: Organisation
org.description: An organisation (enhet) from the Central Coordinating Register, a main unit or a sub-unit (parentPartyId set).

parentPartyId.title: Main unit
parentPartyId.description: For a sub-unit: the party id of its main unit (an organisation in this or another loaded file). The Register links them with the CCR hovedenhet role, so the main unit's roles reach the sub-unit.

name.title: Name
name.description: Organisation name; the display name. Default: the organisation number.

unitType.title: Unit type
unitType.description: CCR organisation form (AS, ENK, STAT, BRL, ...; BEDR for a sub-unit). Default when absent: AS for a main unit, BEDR for a sub-unit, with a load warning: the production Register always has one and Access Management's import rejects an organisation without it.

eMailAddress.title: Registered e-mail address
eMailAddress.description: The e-mail address registered in the CCR (Register's organisation record). Not a notification address: Notifications uses notificationAddresses.

telephoneNumber.title: Telephone number
telephoneNumber.description: Telephone number registered in the CCR.

mobileNumber.description: Mobile number registered in the CCR (Register's organisation record), in full international form (+47...). Not a notification address: Notifications uses notificationAddresses.

faxNumber.title: Fax number
faxNumber.description: Fax number registered in the CCR.

notificationAddresses.title: Official notification addresses (v3)
notificationAddresses.description: The organisation's official notification addresses (contact register for organisations), returned by Profile's organizations/notificationaddresses/lookup for Notifications' and Correspondence's organisation recipients. A sub-unit without any falls back to its main unit's addresses, as Profile does. Default: none, so an order to the organisation alone is rejected (422) unless users registered contact points.

system.title: System
system.description: An end-user system (sluttbrukersystem) with its system users.

name.title: System name
name.description: System name; the system users' display name in the Register.

systemUsers.title: System users
systemUsers.description: The system's users, one per organisation that uses the system.

id.title: System user id
id.description: The system user's UUID, also its Register party UUID (urn:altinn:systemuser:uuid).

orgNumber.description: The organisation that owns the system user; must be an organisation in a loaded file, or the system user is skipped with a load warning.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Actions delegated to the system user (read, write, instantiate, ...). Kept from the old localtest; not read by the new stack yet.
